strategies.name: ETF Shop 28 (28 SMA Momentum)
strategies.rules: Own rules: 30 stocks x 3 tranches (1 bullish + 2 dip, 70% of capital for first buys / 30% for averaging), dip tranches step 5% (price today), dip target 3.14%, bullish min profit 3.14%, dip tranches exit by signal + target

strategies.name: Multi-Engine Darvas Strategy
strategies.rules: Own rules: 25 stocks x 4 tranches (1 bullish + 3 dip), dip tranches bought on its own signal, dip target 5%, bullish sold on signal off if at least 15% a year, dip tranches exit by their own target
